name: independent-restore-missing-file
reviewer: Independent reviewer (Claude Opus 5 CLI documentation review seat)

steps.action: A restored Document whose bytes are missing, and its recovery
steps.actual: One stored blob was removed from the restored target's file volume. The Document row was still listed (true) while its download failed with HTTP 500 — the guide's "listed but its download fails" case. Re-extracting the retained files archive into the same isolated target restored the bytes and the download matched the recorded SHA-256 again.
